_sources: Strength Level community standards (strengthlevel.com/strength-standards, Entire Community levels, fetched 2026-10-08): bodyweight ratios for weighted lifts (dumbbell = one dumbbell), reps for bodyweight moves, seconds for holds. Runs use WMA/USATF 2025 age grading. Rowing, swimming and cycling use Rowing Level, Swimming Level and Cycling Level finish times by age and sex (fetched 2026-10-12); an effort is compared at the nearest tabled distance via Riegel (T2 = T1 × (D2/D1)^1.06). Entries with "benchmark" reuse benchmarks.v1.json thresholds. A standard only covers the exact exercise (or a single-arm/attachment variant of the same movement).
